profile.name: Jin
profile.overview: Jin is an incredibly versatile character, having an answer for every situation. His strengths include powerful punishment, space control with long-ranged keep-out attacks, and excellent close-ranged pressure thanks to his pokes and wavedash mix-ups. His execution requirements are strict in high-level play, but he can be played effectively by beginners and masters alike.
profile.playstyle: The all-rounder. Wavu calls him an answer for every situation: strong punishes, space control, great lows and a parry. Poke with safe mids, flow into Zenshin (ZEN) for mix-ups, and use his Mishima tools (EWHF, crouch dash) to punish. His backdash cancel is sluggish, so rely on sidesteps and parries on defence.
strengths: All Rounder Supreme: Combines outstanding generic tools with a supplementary Mishima moveset
Outstanding Lows: Possesses one of the best low arsenals in the game
Great Defense and Keepout: Amazing keepout with EWHF, standing 4, and f+4, with an i3 strong parry makes him very difficult to pressure
Punishment for everything: Arguably the best punishment suite in the entire game, can launch at i13 and i14 from standing and crouch, respectively
Potent Heat: Gets strong chip potential and one of the scariest Heat Smashes in the game with insane wallsplat potential
weaknesses: Sluggish BDC: One of few characters with a bad backdash cancel
Not a "true" Mishima: Wavedash mixup and d+2 are somewhat reactable
Naughty Boy: Started WWIII in Tekken 6 and still hasn't gone to the Hague for it

stances.name: Zenshin
stances.entry: f+3+4 or b+3+4, and F after b+3 or f+4
stances.note: ZEN.2 is a homing power crush and Heat Engager; ZEN.u+1 tornadoes; ZEN.1 and ZEN.1,3 are his combo tools.

stances.name: Crouch Dash
stances.note: CD.df+1 tornadoes and evades jabs; in Heat it becomes the electric version (Wavu).

heat: Gains access to new follow-ups to his Power Stance (db+1+2)
EWHF can be performed without just frame input.

keyMoves.summary: i10 punish string that wall-splats (Wavu: i10 splat). -13 on block if both hits finish.
keyMoves.use: After -10 moves, especially near the wall.
keyMoves.counterplay: Block the second hit and punish.

keyMoves.use: To check and push the opponent back.

keyMoves.summary: i16 knee, -6 on block, can enter ZEN with F.
keyMoves.use: Mid range pressure and combo filler.
keyMoves.gamePlan: Core move in his combos too.

keyMoves.summary: Front Thrust Kick: i16 mid, -8 on block, launches on counter hit (+42a).
keyMoves.purpose: A long CH launcher that can enter ZEN.
keyMoves.use: At range when they press or step in.

keyMoves.summary: Double Lift Kick: i15 launcher, -19 on block.
Front Jump Kick: i15 launcher, -13 on block.
Crouching Uppercut: i14 while-standing launcher, -12 on block.
Right Sweep: i16 low, -12 on block.
Right Low Roundhouse: i20 low, -13 on block, +13g on counter hit.
keyMoves.purpose: A low with a CH reward.

keyMoves.summary: Demon's Paw: i14 mid Heat Engager, -8 on block.
keyMoves.use: To start Heat and whiff punish.

keyMoves.summary: i12 throw, break with 1 or 2, side switch.

combos.name: Launch BnB: b+3~F ZEN.1 b,f+2,3~F ZEN.u+1 T!
combos.situation: After a regular launch such as d+3+4 or uf+4.

mistakes: Not holding F after b+3, so Zenshin never starts.
Rushing ZEN.u+1 before the stance is ready.
